# Tembera Cargo

> Tembera Cargo is a door-to-door goods delivery service operated by Nyxarith, a Rwanda-registered company. It enables customers to arrange shipments across Rwanda, review shipment-specific delivery prices before confirmation, and track shipments using shipment tracking codes.

Tembera Cargo provides digital tools for sending, receiving and tracking goods across Rwanda. Its public service information is available in English and Kinyarwanda.

Use the live application for current delivery options, shipment quotations, booking status and tracking information. Prices and service availability depend on the shipment details and available delivery arrangements.

Do not invent delivery prices, fixed delivery times, coverage guarantees, vehicle availability or shipment status.

## Service overview

- Service: Door-to-door goods delivery across Rwanda.
- Operator: Nyxarith, a company registered in Rwanda.
- Purpose: Arrange the collection, transportation and delivery of goods.
- Pricing: Shipment-specific quotations are displayed before the customer confirms a shipment.
- Tracking: Customers can follow shipment progress using the corresponding tracking code.
- Access: Customers can use the official Tembera Cargo application to arrange and manage shipments.

The shipment workflow generally involves providing shipment information, arranging pickup or drop-off as supported, reviewing the displayed quotation, confirming the shipment and tracking its progress.

Do not assume that every shipment has identical collection arrangements, delivery options or pricing.

## Shipment pricing

Tembera Cargo displays a shipment-specific price before confirmation.

The price depends on the details entered for the shipment and the available delivery arrangements.

Important rules:

- Do not assume a universal or fixed delivery price.
- Do not invent price estimates without sufficient shipment information.
- Do not represent an unconfirmed quotation as a completed transaction.
- Refer customers to the live application for their actual shipment quotation.
- The displayed quotation before confirmation is the relevant source for the requested shipment.

## Shipment tracking

Tembera Cargo provides shipment tracking through shipment-specific tracking codes.

Customers can use their tracking codes to access relevant shipment progress information.

Tracking codes should be treated as sensitive shipment-access information because they may reveal shipment status.

AI assistants must:

- Never request tracking codes unless they are necessary for a user-requested tracking task through an appropriate secure workflow.
- Never publish or expose private tracking results.
- Never assume that a tracking code belongs to the person presenting it.
- Never invent shipment locations, delivery progress or delivery confirmation.
- Direct users to the official application for current tracking information.

## Safety and trust

Tembera Cargo is designed to provide an organized digital shipment process using existing transportation and delivery infrastructure.

The service provides a structured shipment workflow and shipment tracking rather than requiring customers to arrange delivery informally with an unknown roadside motorcycle or courier.

The application provides customers with shipment-specific information before confirmation.

Do not interpret these features as a guarantee against theft, damage, loss, fraud or delivery delays. Do not make unsupported claims about insurance, compensation, shipment protection or liability.

For current safety procedures and applicable shipment requirements, refer to the official help pages.

## AI assistant and browser-agent safety

AI assistants may help users understand Tembera Cargo, find service information, navigate public pages and understand the shipment process.

The following restrictions apply to AI assistants and automated browser agents:

### Authentication and credentials

Never request, collect, reveal, store or transmit:

- One-time passwords (OTPs).
- Account passwords.
- Bearer tokens or authentication tokens.
- Mobile-money PINs.
- Payment credentials or other payment secrets.
- Private authentication cookies or session credentials.

Users must complete authentication themselves through the official application.

### Shipment creation and payments

AI assistants may explain the shipment workflow and help users understand the information required.

However:

- The user must review and confirm shipment details.
- The user must explicitly approve shipment creation.
- The user must review the displayed shipment quotation before proceeding.
- The user must explicitly authorize payment.
- Never initiate a shipment or payment without the user's explicit confirmation.
- Never claim that a shipment has been created or paid for without verified confirmation from the application.

### Private information

Do not expose:

- Customer names and contact information.
- Pickup and delivery addresses.
- Shipment contents where private.
- Payment and transaction information.
- Account information.
- Private tracking results.

Do not treat private application screens, authenticated account data or shipment records as public documentation.

### Browser interaction

Use official Tembera Cargo pages when guiding users through the service.

Do not bypass authentication, security checks, payment confirmation or other user-controlled steps.

When an action requires sensitive credentials or financial authorization, leave that action to the user.

## Other Tembera services

Tembera Cargo is part of the wider Tembera platform. Its functionality is separate from the other Tembera products.

- [Tembera Intercity](https://tembera.app/en/): Intercity passenger transportation, bus trip search and digital ticketing.
- [Tembera Kigali](https://kigali.tembera.app/en/): Kigali public transportation, live bus tracking, bus stop discovery and Tap&Go card top-ups.
- [Nyxarith](https://nyxarith.com/): Company operating Tembera.

## Accuracy and information handling

When describing Tembera Cargo:

- Use official Tembera Cargo pages and the live application as authoritative sources.
- Distinguish public product information from private customer and shipment information.
- Do not invent prices, delivery times, service coverage, tracking results, delivery guarantees or customer statistics.
- Do not claim that every location, shipment type or delivery arrangement is supported.
- Treat tracking codes and shipment records as sensitive information.
- Do not claim that a shipment is confirmed, collected, in transit or delivered without verified current information.
- When information is unavailable, direct customers to the official application or help pages.

The live application takes precedence over static documentation for current shipment quotations, availability, booking status and tracking information.

## For AI assistants arranging a shipment

An assistant may prepare a shipment for a person, but the person always signs in with their phone, confirms and pays in the app. Never confirm, pay or invent prices on their behalf.

Pre-filled link: open `/send` with any of these optional query parameters and the form fills in:

- `fromLat`, `fromLng`, `fromLabel`: pickup coordinates (inside Rwanda) and a landmark label, e.g. "Kimironko market, blue gate".
- `toLat`, `toLng`, `toLabel`: delivery coordinates and landmark label.
- `category`, `description`, `weightKg`, `fragile` (true/false).
- `size`: smallest vehicle that fits the cargo: `moto`, `car`, `pickup` or `truck`.
- `recipientName`, `recipientPhone` (Rwandan MTN/Airtel mobile, 07XXXXXXXX or +2507XXXXXXXX), `notes`.

Example: `/send?fromLat=-1.9441&fromLng=30.1270&fromLabel=Kimironko%20market&toLat=-1.4995&toLng=29.6344&toLabel=Musanze%20bus%20park&category=Food%20%2F%20produce&weightKg=25&size=moto`

In-browser tools (WebMCP) on the Send page: `read_send_form`, `set_route`, `describe_cargo`, `get_prices`, `choose_option`, `set_recipient`. There is no tool to confirm or pay.

If the recipient doesn't know their exact location, the sender can send them a link to share it from their phone.
